reason: The README clearly describes a settings-page visualization plugin that reads local DeepSeek Harness billing data and presents token totals, trends, heatmaps, and model usage through charts and a statistics API.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的使用统计页面读取本地账单数据，并以统计卡片、热力图、趋势图和模型用量图展示 Token 消耗。
summaries.en: Reads local DeepSeek Harness billing data and displays token consumption through summary cards, heatmaps, trend charts, and model usage visualizations.

capabilities: Displays token consumption statistics and charts in a settings page
Provides a local GET /usage-stats/api endpoint for statistics JSON
Caches statistics data and invalidates it when the billing file changes or the day changes
